name: AInav (AI导航网)

sources.title: Homepage — large active Chinese AI navigation directory (AI导航网), daily-updated listings
提交网站 (Submit Website) page — submission guidelines and live form: name, link, tags, intro, icon, category, nickname, contact

requirements: AI-related product required — '提交的产品是与AI相关，并有良好完整的用户体验' (AI-related with a good, complete UX)
Excluded: ChatGPT wrapper/mirror sites (套壳/镜像站) and illegal sites are not accepted
Prepare before submitting (their words): 工具名称 (name), 链接 (URL), 标签 (tags), 简介 (intro)
Form also asks for an icon (图标, with a 一键填写 auto-fetch button), category from their taxonomy, nickname and contact info (联系方式)
All-Chinese UI — submission is done in Chinese
preparation: Short Chinese-language description/intro — write it in advance
Site icon/logo (form has an auto-fetch '一键填写' helper)
A contact channel (联系方式) — likely QQ/WeChat/email
Pick the right category from their deep taxonomy (AI编程, AI绘画, AI视频工具, AI智能体, etc.)
workflow: Fill: site URL, icon (use 一键填写 to auto-grab), category, tags, intro
Add nickname + contact info under 用户信息
Click 提交审核 (submit for review)
Manual review; no account or payment required
watchFor: Entirely Chinese-language site and form — non-Chinese products can submit but descriptions should be in Chinese
Rejects thin ChatGPT wrappers/mirror sites — submit only if the product has real UX depth
Separate routes exist for 友情链接 (friend link exchanges) and 商业合作 (business cooperation) if you want more than a listing
QQ group (646315110) is their community channel
countsAsLive: The tool appears as a card on ainav.cn under its chosen category, reachable from the homepage sections and site search
unknowns: Whether non-Chinese sites/apps are commonly accepted
Whether contact via QQ/WeChat is mandatory for follow-up
